text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry.
It looks like it's nothing serious, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's head back to the track.
choice_data_list: Are you planning to run already?
Are you planning to run already?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! Sure, I get frequent nosebleeds,
fevers, and hives, but when it comes to energy,
I'm confident I have more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when everyone else is working so hard,
I can't be the only one taking a break!
choice_data_list: For now, you should get some proper rest.
Got it, let's not push ourselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hauu... I had a feeling you would
say that, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, times like this are when I have to work hardest,
otherwise I feel like I'll remain ordinary forever...
choice_data_list: If something happened to you, I wouldn't be able to act normal either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mmh... You make a fair point...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll make sure to rest well today so that I can make a full recovery quickly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser sounded a bit disappointed
as she headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll be careful while running!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The spot I hurt earlier is starting to ache again...
Maybe I got a bit carried away...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm so sorry...
I don't think I can make it today after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser spoke with regret
and headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew... Looks like I won't have to run at full power!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll do my best!
Just like the Trainer said,
I'll make sure not to overdo it! Munh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mindful of her injury, Matikanetannhauser
trained reasonably within her limits.
